# taffy

og-ui's layout core (`crates/og-ui/src/layout/`) lays out CSS Flexbox,
Grid and block flow with floats through the unmodified `taffy` 0.15.1 crate
from https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy, under the MIT licence. `LICENSE`
contains its licence. Source is available from that repository and
https://crates.io/crates/taffy/0.15.1.
